name: probatorium-fastify-server
description: Fastify (Node.js) adapter for the probatorium contract.
//versions: Versions are pinned by the committed lockfile and installed frozen (bun install --frozen-lockfile / npm ci). Bumps land only via a reviewed Dependabot PR — never resolved fresh at deploy time. See .gitignore (Rust block) for why.
//run: `node src/server.js -bind <host:port> [-engine h1|h2c]` is the canonical entry. The ansible node role writes a POSIX-sh launcher at competitors/fastify that execs the bench-installed node on this file, forwarding argv.
